tuning_reason: No Cataclysm, jelly, health, damage, AI or clock tuning
limitations: The initial F3 wave and 12-second wandering observation advance naturally; no jelly tick, steering, health, attack damage or game clock is assigned.
The unrelated single-day scheduler is paused in this owned PIE and restored; the Cataclysm event/liquid/jellies and hero continue ticking.
After the wandering observation, the hero is a disclosed position-only fixture following one moving jelly at approximately 88 cm on verified supported floor. Normal held Pickaxe LMB deals all damage.
A temporary review camera follows the action. The hero is positioned beside an actually wet paint cell for normal held brush LMB; the surviving jelly keeps painting.
Source policy plus actual empty Target, goal changes and travel corroborate independent wandering. Player proximity is not treated as a reliable pursuit test.
The native exact-commit death counters identify burst-added wet cells; ordinary global coverage changes alone are not attributed to the rupture.
Only one jelly is killed. Full encounter cleanup, balance, network behavior, GPU cost and final visual quality remain separate checks.
No editor map changes, package saves, build/cook/package, native damage/care helpers or broad test suite.
Idle is delivered as an authored asset; the existing alive jelly always hops. Solo does not validate network peers.

Inside the existing natural 12-second wander interval, seconds 3–6.5 use the actual possessed hero Camera and view target. A disclosed position/control-facing-only hero fixture follows the moving jelly; no camera boom/FOV/native camera tuning is assigned. Material paths and effective MID parameters are technical evidence; ROOT must inspect rendered colors/highlights/trail readability.

Two synchronous game-thread snapshots compare actual procedural section-0 triangles and bilinear wet mask >63. Three interior barycentric samples per paint triangle plus wet mask-cell centers cannot prove every pixel or material WPO. Existing observer-position fixtures remain disclosed; capsule/floor/indentation measurements distinguish support from visual overlap.
